title: TREAD.FI
summary_title: From Morgan Stanley quant to TradFi founder: How trading infrastructure beats fortune telling
summary_description: David from TradFi discusses leaving TradFi after 7 years, why AI trading agents fail, and building execution-focused infrastructure on Hyperliquid.

key_moments.label: Host Zirk introduces David from TradFi
David's journey: parents taught him to code, chose Waterloo computer science
7 years at Morgan Stanley equities trading desk, working with Vanguard and Citadel orders
Crypto aha moment: Cryptowatch app revealed retail access to institutional-grade data
Left Morgan Stanley 4 years ago; FTX collapsed the week after garden leave ended
TradFi abstracts limit order books; agentic layer executes without manual trading decisions
100B in volume taught him: trading is hard, even quant PhDs can't consistently win
TreadFi name origin: tire treads reduce slippage, like tires on roads
